scope: Disconnect before and after corrective ghost-transfer arrival
result: The existing production fixes pass both disconnect boundaries. This change adds native regression coverage and consolidates the fixture login-component loader; no additional production implementation or SQL migration is required.
checks: 16 new cases:4 native raid difficulties (LFR17/Normal14/Heroic15/Mythic16), Human/Orc, and2 disconnect boundaries. The Player dies/repopulates through real handlers, retaining its corpse in earned raidA. A distinct group-bound B is unloaded with the actual map lifecycle, recreated by SafeTeleport and rejected at WorldPortAck. The real homebind fallback targets native5041 on exterior1220.

Stage1 disconnects with corrective far transfer pending, before its ACK: IsBeingTeleportedFar=true and IsInWorld=false. Stage2 disconnects immediately after successful corrective ACK: in world with no pending transfer. A fixture-owned heap Player is released to the actual WorldSession::Update logout dispatcher, which saves and deletes it.

Actual characters SQL matches the captured native destination/current position, orientation, health, ghost flag, offline state and zone7541. Stage1 saves instance_id0 through the pending-destination branch. Stage2 retains the current exterior map native GetInstanceId value7541; the fixture does not assume stationary and pending saves use identical instance values.

Actual corpse SQL retains exactly one original corpse GUID and raidA instanceId; global owner-cache lookup still returns that corpse. An actual stale WorldPortAck on the deleted Players old session is inert.

Each case constructs a fresh socketless Player, restores actual saved position/orientation/flags/health and executes native prepared group/bind/aura loaders plus LoadCorpse. The normal post-aura DEAD assignment is reproduced. Native CreateMap/AddPlayerToMap selects the exterior. An old-session ACK after this new Player exists must not change its map, saved coordinates/orientation/health, ghost/corpse or transfer state.

The reloaded Player then executes the existing actual entrance720/5775 path into originalA, with earned encounter mask3,50% resurrection and one corpse conversion/deletion. Personal/group bindings and retry remain under the previous native checks.

All88 graveyard/logout cases pass (72 previous plus16 new). The common login-component loader now covers32 ghost relogs;40 complete ghost-return checks, prior different-instance guards and unloaded-target fallback/short-near controls pass. Final DBErrors and Server ERROR counts are zero.

retained_observations: Both native runs passed. The final run adds explicit saved-coordinate/orientation/health assertions after map admission and late ACK. No new production failure was observed or suppressed.

The initial/reference failures from earlier corpse/foreign-instance/unloaded-target fixes remain in their previous audits. This audit does not replace those records or turn them into client verification.
limits: This is synchronous native component testing with socketless sessions and schema-only disposable character/auth data. Logout executes the real session dispatcher, but no physical connection loss, TCP reconnect or authentication is simulated.

The common relog helper explicitly restores selected saved fields and invokes actual prepared loaders. It does not execute aggregate Player::LoadFromDB. Its final death-state assignment matches production ordering but is fixture code; authenticated client login is still unverified.

Both boundaries retain a live earned raidA and its group/save while actors are frozen. Full server restart, corpse expiry/missing corpse, group loss, invalid homebind, source-map destruction and other simultaneous transfer races remain separate cases.

No production sources or canonical runtime artifacts changed, so no redundant server rebuild/startup is claimed. This turn launched no worldserver/bnetserver processes. Canonical Release deployment and prior graceful startup evidence remain in the previous audit.
Client ghost movement, loading, visibility, corpse/bones visuals, camera/pet/UI, actual logout/relogin and retail packet timing still need client confirmation.
